name: production-image-audit-v1
score_formula: Compute the weighted mean of applicable dimensions inside each category, then the weighted mean of the available category scores. Never replace, clamp, or cap the result because of a gate, severity, or individual dimension.

scale_anchors.0: The required visual fact is absent or wholly contradictory.
scale_anchors.2: Severe visible failure; the intended fact is barely recoverable.
scale_anchors.4: Major visible failure that prevents production use without repair.
scale_anchors.6: Minimum usable result with clear but repairable weaknesses.
scale_anchors.8: Strong production result with only minor localized defects.
scale_anchors.10: Nearly flawless visible execution with specific supporting evidence.

evidence_rules: Score only visible image evidence; do not infer that an obscured or unreadable requirement was probably generated correctly.
Every applicable dimension must include observable evidence and every score below 10 must name a concrete defect.
Major and critical defects must include at least one normalized x1,y1,x2,y2 image region.
Hidden, cropped, blurred, or ambiguous required evidence should receive the score supported by the visible pixels; it has no automatic numeric ceiling.
A failed delivery gate or critical severity may independently block production approval, but neither changes the weighted score.
